title: Beyond Restoration: Content-Degradation Factor Unfolding for Real-World Concealed Object Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable visual perception under degradation requires distinguishing task-relevant content from degradation-induced variations, especially in concealed object segmentation (COS), where foreground cues are inherently weak. The central challenge is not merely improving visibility, but identifying reliable content evidence amid degradation-induced variations. RGB-space segmentation often entangles content and degradation cues, while restoration-based methods primarily focus on image recovery and task interaction. This motivates explicit factorization to distinguish content evidence from degradation effects and assess its reliability. Retinex provides a spatially aligned basis for this separation but remains illumination-centric. We therefore extend it to content-degradation formation with task-asymmetric factor roles. translated_title: 超越图像复原：面向真实世界隐蔽目标分割的内容-退化因子展开
translated_abstract: 在退化条件下的可靠视觉感知需要将任务相关内容与退化引起的变化区分开来，尤其是在隐蔽目标分割（COS）任务中，前景线索本身就很微弱。核心挑战不仅在于提升可见性，更在于在退化引起的变化中识别可靠的内容证据。RGB空间中的分割方法往往将内容线索与退化线索纠缠在一起，而基于复原的方法则主要关注图像恢复与任务交互。这促使我们进行显式的因子分解，以区分内容证据与退化效应并评估其可靠性。Retinex理论为这种分离提供了空间对齐的基础，但其仍然以光照为中心。因此，我们将其扩展为具有任务非对称因子角色的内容-退化成像模型。因子展开网络（FUN）使用内容因子R作为分割中唯一的直接语义证据来源。
tldr: 该论文提出因子展开网络（FUN），将Retinex模型扩展为具有任务非对称因子角色的内容-退化因子分解框架，以内容因子作为唯一语义证据来源，从退化变化中提取可靠内容证据，从而实现真实世界隐蔽目标分割。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Factor Unfolding Network (FUN), which extends Retinex into a content-degradation factorization model with task-asymmetric factor roles, using the content factor as the sole source of direct semantic evidence to identify reliable content cues amid degradation for real-world concealed object segmentation.
